title: Louis A. Horvitz Visiting Professor of Law
bio: Sergio J. Campos is Professor of Law at Boston College Law School and currently serves as the Faculty Director of LLM and Global Programs. His research and teaching interests include civil procedure, federal courts, and comparative law, with a special focus on complex litigation.
